documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: PLA Galaxy
Bambu PLA Galaxy Safety Data Sheet SDS20251127A15
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PLA Galaxy
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 21 ± 4 MPa, elongation 7.1 ± 0.9 %, bending modulus 1850 ± 140 MPa, bending strength 37 ± 3 MPa, impact 5.8 ± 1.2 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density, melting, glass transition, Vicat and HDT are raw-material properties (ISO 1183, DSC, ISO 306, ISO 75) and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 1540 ± 190 MPa, Z 1320 ± 150 MPa), melt index (11.0 ± 1.7 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature ("/"), heat deflection temperature 55 °C at 0.45 MPa, saturated water absorption rate (0.45% at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed with desiccant), nozzle size (0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm), bed surface preparation (glue), retraction length (0.6 - 1.0 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C), max overhang angle (55 °), max bridging length (~ 30 mm), support material (Support for PLA), spool material (ABS, temperature resistance 70 °C) and spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), suggested annealing (50 to 60 °C, 6 to 12 hours), odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products rows.
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting.
The TDS "Bed Surface Preparation Glue" is a recommended setting, not a stated requirement, so no "requires" relation is written.

Source disagreement left to review: the TDS Nozzle Size row lists 0.2 mm, while the store page (Cautions for Use: "0.2 mm Nozzle NOT Compatible"), the store FAQ ("Not compatible with ... Hotend with Stainless Steel Nozzle 0.2 mm.") and the PLA wiki exclude it. The relation not_compatible_with "0.2 mm Nozzle" carries the conflict.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: model "A15-xx", CLP "Not classified", and "Not hazardous goods" for sea (IMDG), DOT, road (ADR/RID) and air (ICAO/IATA) transport. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values.

The material-table wiki does not name PLA Galaxy anywhere. Its note ② defines "PLA" as standard PLA without hard, large-particle fillers and lists neither PLA Galaxy (glass microsphere additives) among the included nor among the excluded types, so its generic "PLA" values (nozzle 190 - 240 °C, bed 45 - 65 ℃ on the Engineering, Smooth PEI / High-Temperature and Textured PEI plates, blast-oven drying 55 ℃ for 8 h, AMS 2 Pro / AMS HT 45 ℃ for 12 h) are not applied to this product.

Marketing prose proves no number: "Appealing from Every Angle", "Sleek Glossy Finish", "Effortless Printing" (store page) and "exceptional strength and toughness you expect from PLA Basic" (TDS Basic Info) are not stored as values.

Hex: all 4 store colours have exactly one hex cell, matched by the colour name without the code in parentheses (the hex table describes each colour, e.g. "Nebulae (Deep blue base with green shimmer)").

The store page links a "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/f3d62272f8f1484b84edb469e63a4292.pdf) that was not cached and not read, so safety.certifications is neither curated nor marked not_published.
material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.03 mm) is the store page's own row (Product Features › bullet 5); the TDS gives no tolerance, so it is not restated here and not marked not_published.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).
The store FAQ (3.Safety Tips) says the filament "is not food-grade"; no registry key holds it.
